subject: health
concept: Understanding how infectious disease spreads through a population and factors that slow or speed that spread
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to P6's germ-spread unit at greater depth — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described population factor (density, hygiene habits, vaccination rates) to its effect on disease spread
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described factor could speed up or slow down the spread of an infectious disease in a population

misconception_flags: believes disease spread through a population depends on random chance alone with no identifiable contributing factors

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
